content: Kono, ndee rewde ɓe fuɗɗinaama haa jooɗi kadi, haa ko soldaadu 800,000 haa ko'e mum e Armée Mawɓe Soviet Union ɓe yillinaama haa ɓe hollinaama Belarusiya haa Ukraina fronts, haa ko ɓe injillinaama leydi ɓe yilliima Poland e hakkunde Riga Peace Treaty, Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, haa ndee juraaji ɗi-ɗi kala, haa ko ɓe bilateral haa multilateral.
